scope: timer and interruption intents for air fryers and kitchen scales

mixed: I'd set the scale tonight if it could turn itself on right when prep starts tomorrow.
睡前选好程序，早上六点让炸锅自己开始加热。
Queue tomorrow's cook tonight, with the heater starting at the hour I pick.
能不能约在做饭前十分钟唤醒秤，我不用再去按开关键。
I need to programme the fryer to begin forty minutes after I load it.
设个预约时间，到点秤自动开机等我来称。
Let the scale wake at a chosen time so I can step straight into measuring.
让我预约启动时间，到点后空气炸锅自动开机烹饪。
After the timer rings, switch the heat off on its own instead of waiting for me.
称完五分钟没有动作，秤就自己关机省电吧。
Shut the scale down automatically after the set idle time.
烹饪计时归零要自动切断加热，别只发出提示声。
When I forget the scale on the counter, have it power off by itself.
预约的是停止加热的时间，到点直接关，不是开机时间。
Set a fixed end time that stops the air fryer even if nobody is home.
希望我能设定多久不用就自动关秤。
A battery swap shouldn't wipe the weighing session. Bring back the prior tare and running total.
停电几十秒再来电，能记住炸到哪一步并从那一步接着做吗？
After a momentary blackout, let me continue the same program with its remaining cook time.
秤中途断电，重新开机希望还能接着之前的配方称，不用把累计重量清零。
Restore the cook progress after the plug gets knocked out and I reconnect it.
换完电池请恢复断电前的去皮和累计值，从原来的称量继续。
If the scale loses power mid-recipe, save enough state to carry on from that measurement.
插头意外掉了，恢复供电后保留原来的温度和剩余分钟，别整个程序重头开始。
The scale timer did something unexpected somewhere near the end.
昨天跳闸那回机器表现怪怪的，具体是开还是关我也没注意。
The cooking timer is confusing. I can't tell which option I was on.
数字忽然跳了一下，会不会与我碰到开关有关？
I'd like the display to show a negative value when I lift part of a measured ingredient out.
出风口不该朝侧边喷油烟，靠墙时太难擦。
Please use firmer cardboard so the box doesn't collapse when I stack it.
秤盘的边缘太滑，碗放上去容易移位。
negative: Give the scale a scheduled wake-up for my regular morning baking.
我想选晚上七点开炸，六点出门的时候先把开机时间定好。
Let me store a start time so dinner begins cooking at six on the dot.
希望称重前可以设好开机钟点，早上到点自动亮屏。
I'd use a timer that automatically turns the scale on before my alarm.
选好食谱放着，等到预约的钟点再开机开始做。
At the end of the set cook, shut off the heat automatically without my intervention.
秤待机一段时间后应自己关掉，不要一直亮着。
Put the scale on an automatic power-off timer after my last measurement.
我定的关火时间一到就停止加热，否则容易烤糊。
Cut power to the heater at the end of the countdown even if I don't press stop.
秤要在无人操作时按设定时长自动关机。
The startup light looked different last night, but I'm not sure what I did.
说明书上的图跟面板长得不大一样。
A solid blue finish would fit my kitchen better.
能送一张防滑垫就好了。
The box got crushed at the corner on arrival.
昨天用过一次，就是有点说不上来哪里不顺手。
